html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A new Super Villain rises to defend her fellow Black Order

as many other powerful heroes return to MARVEL Future Fight!

 

We introduce the March Update in celebration of the addition of the Black Swan.

 

Angel, who possesses great power and

excellent flying abilities, has received Tier-4 Advancement.

In addition, Black Swan, a native Tier-3 Super Villain with all kinds of superhuman abilities

including the optical blast that creates energy explosions, has entered the battle.

 

Also, new uniforms have been added for Thanos,

the leader of the Black Order and the most powerful being in the universe,

and Angel and Satana, whose angel and demon forms are reversed.

 

Lastly, various improvements, including the addition and improvement of World Boss,

have been prepared so that all Agents can enjoy the game more conveniently.

Please check the details below!

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Black Swan <Black Order>,

a member of the Black Swans with superhuman abilities.

* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

▣ Three New Uniforms & Uniform Improvements

 

1. Three new Uniforms have been added in celebration of the Black Swan themed update.

Check out the abilities of Thanos <Thanos Wins>, Angel <Fallen One>, and Satana <Ascended One>.

 

* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

 

* The new Uniform Thanos <Thanos Wins> will be on sale for 40% off
  during the <March Update Celebration Event>, and can be checked and purchased
  in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.


* The new Uniforms, Angel <Fallen One> and Satana <Ascended One>
  can be purchased during the event period.

 

▶ Satana <Ascended One>

After the 3/26 Update - 4/12 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 3/26 Update - 4/12 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT)

- Purchase method: Can be exchanged at the Event Token Shop with Clever Mischief Tokens

- Clever Mischief Tokens can be acquired by purchasing event products or through other methods

  until 4/9 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0) and  4/9 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT).

 

▶ Angel <Fallen One>

After the 3/26 Update - 4/9 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 3/26 Update - 4/9 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

- Purchase method: Crystal purchase (Discount event will not be applied.)

* Seasonal Uniforms may be available for purchase again

  after the event has been over through similar events or packages.

 

2. Certain Skills of Thanos <Wise Harvester> have been improved.

 

* Thanos <Wise Harvester> can be purchased during the event period.

▶ Thanos <Wise Harvester>

After the 3/26 Update - 4/9 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),

After the 3/26 Update - 4/9 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

- Purchase method: Crystal purchase (Discount event will not be applied.)

* Seasonal Uniforms may be available for purchase again

  after the event has been over through similar events or packages.

 

▣ Angel Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Angel, a founding member

of the original X-Men and a harbinger of hope and heroism.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

▣ Black Swan Tier-3

 

Black Swan, the final member of the Black Order, has received Tier-3 Advancement.

 

 

▣ Satana and Hellstorm Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the March Update, Satana and Hellstorm

will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ New World Boss: Legend+ <Black Swan> Release

& World Boss Improvements

 

Black Swan, a new member of the Black Order who possesses superhuman abilities,

has appeared as the first boss in World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.

 

The new World Boss difficulty <Legend+> is harder to clear than the Legend difficulty,

but the rewards are higher.

 

▶ World Boss: Legend+ <Black Swan> Release

 

1. Agents can challenge Black Swan from Difficulty 1 after clearing the unlock Challenges.

- Unlock Requirements:

  Clear Story stage 8-3, Own three or more Tier-4 heroes, Clear all World Boss Challenges

- World Boss stages above every 10 level are locked with specified Challenges,

  including those involving specific heroes.

 

 

 

 

2. Black Swan’s Conquer Level can be achieved up to 200, and the conquer effect can be upgraded

along with acquiring Odin's Blessing Chest, Dimension Chest: C.T.P, and Tier-3 growth materials.

- The Conquer Effect that applies to Black Swan has been added to

  Kang the Conqueror’s Conquer Effect depending on his Conquer level.

 

 

3. Clear the new World Boss Legend+: Black Swan to acquire various rewards.

​- The Mighty C.T.P. of Energy, Regeneration, Destruction, Judgment, 

  Authority, Greed, Refinement, and Insight can be acquired 

  when clearing World Boss: Legend+ Black Swan.

- Cosmic Cube Fragments can be acquired at a 100% rate from the World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.

 

 

▶ World Boss Improvements

 

1. Titan's Record Guarantee System

The bonus reward gauge will be charged if you do not obtain Titan's Records

when clearing Ultimate, Legend, or Legend+ World Boss.

Once fully charged, you will obtain Selector: Titan's Record.

* The gauge will be reset if you obtain a Titan’s Record during charging.

* If you do not acquire gauge rewards when it is at 100%, the gauge will no longer be charged.

 

 

2. The Difficulty tab for the World Boss has been changed.

- Before: All, Ultimate, Legend

- After: Ultimate, Legend

 

 

3. Today's World Boss is divided into difficulty levels (Ultimate / Legend)

so Agents can reset Today's World Boss of a desired difficulty level.

* Ex) Today’s World Boss: (Ultimate) Proxima Midnight, (Legend) Knull

* Only the world boss corresponding to the selected difficulty level

   will be displayed when changing Today's World Boss.

* Today's World Boss set before the Update will reset

   by the difficulty level after the maintenance ends.

* With this improvement, the list of [Today's World Boss] for Ultimate/Legendary difficulty will change.

   We recommend that you avoid changing Today's World Boss before the Update.

 

 

4. World Boss: Legend Difficulty First Clear Reward has been reset.

The rewards for first clearing World Boss: Legend difficulty

will be reset after the update excluding Black Swan.

- The reset first clear reward can be obtained when clearing the corresponding World Boss Level.

- Artifacts will be added as the first clear rewards for Kang the Conqueror, Dark Phoenix, and Gorr.

- First clear rewards from Level 10 and above will be newly added each 5 and 10 levels.

 

5. Unlock conditions for Knull, Mephisto, Infinity Ultron, and Gorr have been simplified.

 

6. The balance of certain bosses on the World Boss: Legend difficulty has been adjusted.

- Infinity Ultron and Gorr: Adjustments in certain patterns and lowering stats

- Kang the Conqueror: Improvements in certain patterns for the convenience

- Dark Phoenix: Adjustment of the pattern of the phase 3

 

7. The gimmick and visibility of <Blade Twister>, the stage special effect

and the World Boss’ special ability, have been improved.

- Improvements of the warning effect of Blade Twister

- Adjustment of Blade Twister's appearance time and location and lowering of its movement speed

 

8. Challenge record rankings will be reset for the entire World Boss and individuals.

* The Ranking in the [Menu(Ranking) - World Boss] will not be reset.

 

[added on 3/27 (Wed) 6:14 (UTC+0), 3/26 (Tue) 23:14 (PDT)]
9. Agents can easily obtain certain types of Titan's Record 
when defeating World Boss: Legend listed below.

 

* The chance of acquiring Titan's Record is the same as before, 

   but the chance of acquiring each type has been set higher for each boss.

 

▣ New Artifacts & Improvements

 

1. Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Black Swan, Satana, and Hellstorm have been added.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

2. The Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Thanos has been improved.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

 

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season

  the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.

- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase

  when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

         

​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, and two more from the upcoming Event!

 

[March Update New Special Icon]

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. ‘Quick Upgrade’ in the Inventory → Upgrade → ISO-8 has been changed to the ‘Upgrade All’.

- Up to 10 ISO-8 can be batch enhanced.

 

 

 

* Any ISO-8 you want to keep can be used as an enhancing material if you do not use Boost ISO-8 as an enhancing material. Please use the lock function to avoid this problem.

 

2. The Daily Task button will appear on the main lobby screen in the game

if there are Achievements or rewards available for Daily Challenges.

You can go to the Challenges menu by pressing the Daily Task button.

- The Daily Task button will disappear when you acquire all Daily Challenge rewards.

 

 

3. The function to batch craft Story Fragment Chests has been added to the Story → Craft Chest menu.

 

 

4. Agents can now set the clear count of Dimension Missions manually up to 40 times.

 

 

5. Convenience related to enhancing Artifacts has been improved.

- Enhancement will repeat until it reaches the set level when using the Auto Enhancement button.

- Apply Max Chance checkbox has been added.

 

 

 

6. The displaying standards for the in-game notification mark (red dot) have been improved.

- The red dot will not be displayed if the notification is unnecessary.

- A separate label will be displayed instead of the red dot in certain contents.

 

7. Agents can check the popularity ranking of heroes

    when selecting a hero using Selector: Biometrics and X-Genes.

 

8. Improvements are made with the Agent Badge.

- It will no longer allow selecting materials when enhancing the Agent Badge at its maximum level.

- The maximum level of the Agent Badge has been expanded from LV. 999 to LV. 1999.

 

9. Certain Challenge in Path of an Agent has been changed.

- #20: [Story] Clear 1 time → [Preview Skill] Practice Combo 1 time

 

10. Certain Challenge rewards in S.H.I.E.L.D Academy have been changed.

- Agent Training #59: 3★ Comic Card Chest x1 → 3★ Comic Card: 1872 #1 x6

- Agent Training #63: 3★ Custom Gear Chest x1 → ★3 Boost Obelisk x1

- Agent Training #79: 3★ Enchanted Uru Chest x1 → ★3 Enchanted Uru: Physical Attack x2

- Agent Training #84: 6★ ISO-8 Chest x1 → ★5 Powerful ISO-8 x2, ★6 Boost ISO-8 x12

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The Basic Defense increase effect of Carnage <Fallen Soul> Leader Skill

not being applied when overlapped with the Defense increase effect of ISO-8 has been fixed.

2. The following that occurred in connection with the C.T.P of Conquest has been fixed.

- The Wall effect of C.T.P. of Conquest does not affect Reflect damage

- The Damage Decrease Ignore effect does not activate normally

  when the Wall effect of C.T.P. of Conquest is activated

3. The issue where Spider-Man's Tier-4 Striker skill could remove the Alliance Battle Boss' penalty buff has been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
